name: Burning Foundation Environmental Programs
summary: Grants of USD 5,000 to 15,000 to 501(c)(3) public charities in Washington and Oregon that preserve habitat that supports biodiversity, with preference for local and statewide groups. Two letter-of-interest cycles a year.

eligibility.rule: Be a 501(c)(3) public charity classified under 509(a)(1) or 509(a)(2)
Not a request for multi-year support
Not request support for research projects or scholarships
Not be a school, university or fundraising affiliate
No habitat restoration that does not restore habitat to its native state
No habitat restoration in areas fragmented by agricultural use
No restoration work on state or federal land
